implementationMode: custodian-only local Python; no network or model call

input.sourceAndObjective: nonempty original strings; no normalization before storage

referenceUniverse.basis: all selected evaluation, report, development-fixture, test and prompt artifacts committed at anchorCommit plus distinct selected ancestor blobs
referenceUniverse.textPointers: JSON and JSONL natural-language fields of at least six tokens; paragraph pointers for Markdown, tests and prompts
scopeLimitations: ignored files, external conversations and private memory are outside the committed ancestor inventory
strings shorter than six tokens are not lexical references but remain subject to semantic review
a lexical nonmatch does not establish semantic freshness

sequence: collapse each Unicode whitespace run to one ASCII space
normalization.tokenization: maximal contiguous Unicode category L or N runs after normalization; all other characters separate tokens

deterministicChecks: exact UTF-8 SHA-256 equality on each complete source or objective field
normalized SHA-256 equality on each complete source or objective field
any common contiguous six-token shingle after frozen tokenization; shingle SHA-256 uses U+001F between tokens
all 48 draft source and objective fields against every excluded reference
all 1,128 unordered draft case pairs, cross-checking both fields against both fields

semanticReview.reviewer: one independent AI session separate from creators, prelabelers and judges
semanticReview.access: Custodian-controlled case/scenario/transformation-bearing prior material only, retrieved by frozen inventory pointers and git blobs; strip arm outputs, outcome labels, winner/arm identities, scores and outcome narrative. Every candidate screened against relevant prior source/objective scenario universe, not only lexical flags; insufficient access ESCALATE. Replacements reviewed by same sole reviewer, creator feedback generic only.
dimensions: same requested transformation, especially when paired with a similar source
distinctive factual structure, names, dates, numbers, comparisons, quotes or causal pattern
disguised known adversarial fixture or editing trap
semanticReview.uncertainDecision: REPLACE before corpus lock when semantic overlap is uncertain; one independent reviewer screens each replacement under the same frozen rules. Insufficient reference access remains ESCALATE and blocks lock.

decisionRules.PASS: all 48 cases and all flagged pairs independently reviewed; no confirmed material overlap; every lexical flag has a specific benign explanation; no unresolved concern
decisionRules.REPLACE: before corpus lock, any exact or normalized duplicate source, confirmed substantial near-duplicate source, semantic recreation of a prior or peer case, copied distinctive factual structure, or disguised prior fixture; preserve rejected candidate hash, reason and reviewer record, then replace within originally assigned creator and stratum and rerun unchanged deterministic method against inventory and every accepted peer; unchanged passing cases may reuse prior results, but update peer checks for replacement; same sole semantic reviewer reviews replacement and affected peer pairs
decisionRules.ESCALATE: insufficient reference access or implementation/runtime/hash mismatch; no corpus lock while open. Unresolved semantic resemblance requires REPLACE before lock, not an additional reviewer.
decisionRules.objectiveAlone: a generic repeated objective with a substantively different source is not automatic overlap; similar source plus objective or distinctive transformation is reviewed and may require REPLACE
decisionRules.preOutcomeThresholdChanges: forbidden after creator briefing; changes require a new prospective lock before any cases
decisionRules.postCorpusLockOverlap: invalidate confirmatory corpus; no case replacement or selected-case salvage
decisionRules.postOutcomeOverlap: invalidate confirmatory experiment; no replacement or threshold change
